description: The settings' round trip on Library Maintenance's Settings tab as admin. The tab shows the saved settings; Export (the page's own download, caught before it reaches the disk) gives the file; a field outside the index's scope (the wait) is saved at once; a scope change (a library chosen) opens the preview dialog, and Cancel saves nothing; a scope change with an excluded folder shows the counts the index then has, and is saved; Diagnostics shows the new index's numbers; the exported file imported through the page's file input shows its dialog and puts back the settings and their version exactly; the same file again has nothing to import. A server message with markup stays text. Find duplicate movies off hides the Duplicates tab (its API 404) and on brings it back. A phone (375 and 320 px) and the dialog there have no sideways scrolling; on the TV, Down from the tab reaches the switch, OK turns it, and the dialog's focus starts on Cancel and returns to Save. The settings are back as they were at the end; a run that stops early can leave them changed (the first steps then refuse to start: put them back by hand). Since Library Maintenance 1.1.0.5, the web client's and Move's four switches: their labels and the note not to use Disable, Move media off (no planning, its routes 403) and on again, and the web client's script off (no tag in index.html) and on again.
